# Official ACT snapshot

This directory contains the DETR/CVAE model files from
[`tonyzhaozh/act`](https://github.com/tonyzhaozh/act), commit
`742c753c0d4a5d87076c8f69e5628c79a8cc5488`. The ACT MIT license and vendored
DETR Apache-2.0 license are included beside their respective sources.

NERO changes are intentionally limited to configurable state/action dimensions,
device selection, package-relative imports, and optional backbone weights.
